name: leadhub
description: Access to the Leadhub MCP server: reads businesses, campaigns, products, interest lists, RFM, and analytics, creates and edits audiences, and edits campaign emails. Includes ten workflows for analytics, campaign content, segmentation, marketing strategy, and email editing.

interface.longDescription: Connects to the Leadhub MCP server. Its tools read businesses, campaigns, products, interest lists, RFM profiles, and analytics. Audiences can be created, edited, copied, and deleted, and a delete is confirmed by the user first. Campaign emails can be edited: an edit saves a new revision in the Leadhub email editor and never sends a campaign. Ten bundled workflows cover period review, email, SMS, retention, RFM, traffic, campaign content, segmentation, marketing strategy, and email editing. Analytics tools return one period at a time; a comparison is a second call. Money from email and SMS tools is in the business primary currency.
defaultPrompt: Summarize this business for the last 30 days against the previous 30.
Explain why email revenue changed in the selected period.
Find my latest email campaign and show its results.
